# Temple Scroll Column 23 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 23 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**23:1** You shall offer upon it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your tithes and your voluntary offerings, and all your choicest votive offerings that you vow to Me.

**23:2** You shall eat there before Me with rejoicing — you and your households, your sons and your daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levite who dwells within your gates, for he has no portion or inheritance among you.

**23:3** Take care not to offer your burnt offerings in any place you see. Only in the place that I choose within one of your tribes shall you offer your burnt offerings.

**23:4** There you shall do all that I command you: your burnt offerings and your sacrifices, your tithes and your voluntary offerings, and all the choicest of your vows that you vow to Me.

**23:5** You shall not offer upon it any unauthorized incense or burnt offering or grain offering; nor shall you pour upon it any unsanctioned drink offering.

**23:6** You shall sacrifice the peace offerings, and you shall eat there and rejoice before Me at your appointed feasts.

**23:7** You shall offer upon the altar the daily burnt offering: a yearling lamb without blemish in the morning, and the second lamb you shall offer at twilight.

**23:8** With it, a tenth of fine flour mixed with a quarter-hin of beaten oil, and a drink offering of a quarter-hin of wine — a fire-offering, a pleasing aroma to Me, the LORD.

**23:9** On the Sabbath day: two yearling lambs without blemish, with two-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and its drink offering.

**23:10** This is the burnt offering of the Sabbath, each Sabbath, in addition to the daily burnt offering and its drink offering.

**23:11** You shall make atonement upon the horns of the altar once each year. With the blood of the sin offering of atonement, once each year he shall make atonement upon it.

**23:12** Throughout your generations, it shall be most holy to Me, the LORD.

**23:13** At the beginning of each month, you shall offer a burnt offering to Me: two young bulls from the herd, one ram, and seven yearling lambs without blemish.

**23:14** Three-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for each bull, and two-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for the ram.

**23:15** A tenth of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering for each lamb — a burnt offering, a fire-offering, a pleasing aroma to Me, the LORD.

**23:16** Their drink offerings: half a hin for each bull, a third of a hin for the ram, and a quarter of a hin for each lamb, of wine. This is the monthly burnt offering, month by month, throughout the months of the year.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus translation of Column 23. "Peace offerings" retained over PNEUMA's "fellowship offerings" as the traditional rendering of shelamim. "At twilight" adopted from LOGOS over EMET's "between the evenings." "Most holy" maintained per project convention.*
